Если основной провайдер не даст первый т: If the primary provider does not deliver the first token within the hedge delay, the same question goes to the fallback in parallel; whichever is faster wins.
Сколько секунд ждать первый токен от осн: How many seconds to wait for the first token from the primary provider before starting the fallback. Lower is faster, but more often sends two requests instead of one.
Устройство ввода, с которого распознаётс: Input device the speech is captured from. When “default” is selected, the system recording device is used.
Microphone — questions are taken from the mic. Speaker — questions are recognised from the speaker audio (loopback device).
Устройство захвата звука динамика (WASAP: Speaker-audio capture device (WASAPI loopback). Used in “Speaker” mode to recognise the interviewer's questions.
Размер основной whisper-модели: tiny…lar: Size of the main whisper model: tiny…large-v3-turbo. large-v3-turbo is the fastest large model — a good speed/quality trade-off for Russian + English terms. Bigger is more accurate but slower and more memory-hungry.
Точность вычислений whisper: int8 — быст: Whisper compute type: int8 — faster (CPU), int8_float32 — GPU without fp16 (Pascal), float16 — Turing+, float32 — more accurate.
Beam для финального декода (качество рас: Beam size for the final decode (recognition quality): 1 — faster, 5 — more accurate on fast speech; the final pass uses speculative decoding, so the beam does not slow the answer down.
Язык распознавания (например, ru). Пусто: Recognition language (e.g. ru). Empty — automatic language detection.
